definitions.full: H3007. yabbesheth [ יבֶּ֫שֶׁת ] noun feminine earth (so Syriac; ᵑ7 as Biblical Hebrew יַבָּשָׁה dry land , √ יָבֵשׁ ); — emphatic יַבֶּשְׁתָּא Dan 2:10 .

occurrences.englishText: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler, has asked such a thing of any magician, or enchanter, or Chaldean.
